images.alt: Андский кондор на фоне зеленых склонов возле Отавало — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, wide landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration for Parque Condor, the raptor rescue and environmental education center near Otavalo, Ecuador. One anatomically accurate adult male Andean condor perched on a low natural volcanic stone at right foreground: large black body, broad white feather collar at base of bare dark reddish head, white upper-wing patches, realistic hooked beak and comb, folded wings. Green cultivated Andean hills and softly distant Imbabura volcanic ridge in the background, highland sky with soft broken clouds, natural crisp morning light. No eagle hybrids, no captive bird carrying a person, no fantasy plumage, no invented buildings, no claim of wild sighting. Calm dignified naturalistic travel illustration, open left half for website text, no text, watermark, logos, cages or collage.
